observations.body: Ministry renounces concealment and shines light. Therefore, seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint. seeing it is God who said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
